concerns.text: The plan applies Benjamini‑Hochberg FDR correction *within each tissue* only ("Apply BH FDR correction across all tested genes *within* each tissue"). This does not control the family‑wise false discovery rate across the full set of tests (genes × tissues). Conducting separate corrections per tissue inflates the overall false‑positive rate; a global correction across all gene‑tissue tests (or a hierarchical approach) is required for proper multiple‑testing control.
